headline: Albudaiwi: GCC economies have proven their ability to deal with economic and financial challenges
summary: GCC Secretary General Jasim Albudaiwi said Gulf economies have proven their ability to handle economic and financial challenges. He cited a $4 trillion market value for Gulf financial markets at end-2026.
why: The Gulf Cooperation Council is a regional bloc of six Gulf states whose financial markets and oil-dependent economies draw significant international investor attention.
